test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 31 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Δ ABC is similar to Δ PQR. The area of Δ ABC is 64 cm², and the area of Δ PQR is 121 cm². If QR = 15.4 cm, what is the length of BC?
solution:
Given:

ΔABC is similar to ΔPQR

Area of ΔABC is 64 cm2

Area of ΔPQR is 121 cm2

QR = 15.4 cm 

Concept: 

The ratio of the areas of two similar triangles is equal to the ratio of the squares of the corresponding sides & medians. 

**Calculations:**

According to concept:

area(ΔABC)/area(ΔPQR) = BC2/QR2

⇒ 64/121 = BC2/QR2 

⇒ √(64/121) = BC/QR

⇒ 8/11 = BC/15.4

⇒BC = (15.4 × 8)/11

⇒BC = 11.2

∴ BC = 11.2 cm
